prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 17 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1319; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with a wrist fracture. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported crash, and the presentation is plausible for this type of impact. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the fracture. The patient underwent immobilization followed by a structured rehabilitation program across 17 visits. Treatment followed a typical course, with visit frequency tapering as range of motion, grip strength, and pain improved. The patient's history includes a remote minor strain to the same region many years ago, which resolved completely without residual limitation and did not affect the current course of care. Billed services reflect the treatment delivered, with no repeated or duplicate charges identified. Current status is improved function with ongoing home exercises, and no further scheduled visits are anticipated at this time.
